Name: <path>
Description: Top-level path primitive routing to UNC/absolute/relative/extended paths

Name: <unc-path>
Description: Universal Naming Convention path for network resources (\\server\share\path)

Name: <absolute-path>
Description: Absolute path with drive letter or root directory (C:\path or \path)

Name: <relative-path>
Description: Relative path from current working directory

Name: <extended-path>
Description: Extended-length path with \\?\ prefix for paths exceeding MAX_PATH

Name: <drive>
Description: Drive letter followed by colon (e.g. C: D: Z:)

Name: <name>
Description: File or directory name with reserved name validation

Name: <share>
Description: UNC share name identifying shared resource

Name: <letter>
Description: Alphabetic drive letter character (A-Z or a-z)
